event_format.canonical_order: stimulus strictly ascending neuron index, then noise strictly ascending neuron index

common_error_behavior: Illegal writes return AXI SLVERR, latch ERROR_STATUS, and enter ERROR. Illegal reads return AXI SLVERR and enter ERROR. ERROR remains latched until SOFT_RESET. Reads explicitly valid anytime remain available in ERROR.

registers.name: PROTOCOL_ID
registers.error_behavior: write is invalid address/protocol error 7

registers.name: CONTROL
registers.legal_fsm_states: all for bit0; READBACK for bit1
registers.valid_timing: bit0 SOFT_RESET anytime; bit1 ACK_READBACK only in READBACK
registers.side_effects: bit0 starts reset sequence and dominates; bit1 clears DONE snapshot state and enters LOAD for the next timestep
registers.error_behavior: reserved/nonzero unsupported command or ACK outside READBACK -> error 1

registers.name: STATUS
registers.error_behavior: write -> error 7

registers.name: TIMESTEP_ID
registers.legal_fsm_states: LOAD for write; all for read
registers.valid_timing: write before the first EVENT_DATA of a timestep
registers.side_effects: selects the timestep to commit; first ID after reset is 0 and subsequent IDs increment by one
registers.error_behavior: write outside LOAD or after event acceptance -> error 1; wrong sequence detected at commit -> error 5

registers.name: EVENT_COUNT
registers.legal_fsm_states: LOAD for write; all for read
registers.valid_timing: write before the first EVENT_DATA of a timestep
registers.error_behavior: out of range, outside LOAD, or after event acceptance -> error 4

registers.name: EVENT_DATA
registers.side_effects: write response is withheld until exactly one frozen formal_top evt_valid/evt_ready handshake; accepted count increments once
registers.error_behavior: bad encoding/index -> error 2; noncanonical/duplicate -> error 3; excess or illegal timing -> error 4

registers.name: EVENT_COMMIT
registers.valid_timing: after accepted count equals EVENT_COUNT and core is idle
registers.side_effects: bit0=1 enters ARM; ARM emits one core step_commit pulse, timestep 0 starts only after this pulse
registers.error_behavior: bad command/state -> error 1; count mismatch -> error 4; ID mismatch -> error 5; busy -> error 6

registers.name: EVENT_ACCEPTED_COUNT
registers.error_behavior: write -> error 7

registers.name: COMPLETED_TIMESTEP_ID
registers.legal_fsm_states: DONE, READBACK; readable anytime for diagnostics
registers.valid_timing: snapshot becomes valid when core step_done is latched
registers.error_behavior: write -> error 7

registers.name: STATE_INDEX
registers.legal_fsm_states: READBACK for write; all for read
registers.error_behavior: write outside READBACK or index >470 -> error 1

registers.name: STATE_DATA
registers.valid_timing: stable after STATE_INDEX write completes and until next index/write/reset
registers.side_effects: returns sign-extended exact raw signed S18/F13 two's-complement value
registers.error_behavior: read outside READBACK -> error 1; write -> error 7

registers.name: DN_COUNTER_INDEX
registers.legal_fsm_states: READBACK for write; all for read
registers.error_behavior: write outside READBACK or index >31 -> error 1

registers.name: DN_COUNTER_DATA
registers.valid_timing: stable after DN_COUNTER_INDEX write completes and until next index/write/reset
registers.error_behavior: read outside READBACK -> error 1; write -> error 7

registers.name: ACC_SAT_COUNTER
registers.error_behavior: read outside READBACK -> error 1; write -> error 7

registers.name: STATE_SAT_COUNTER
registers.error_behavior: read outside READBACK -> error 1; write -> error 7

registers.name: FIFO_OVERFLOW
registers.error_behavior: read outside READBACK -> error 1; write -> error 7

registers.name: EVENT_DROP
registers.error_behavior: read outside READBACK -> error 1; write -> error 7

registers.name: TIMESTEP_CYCLES
registers.side_effects: core model-execution cycles only; host load/readback time is excluded
registers.error_behavior: read outside READBACK -> error 1; write -> error 7

registers.name: ERROR_STATUS
registers.side_effects: none; first error wins until reset
registers.error_behavior: write -> error 7 and cannot clear the existing latched error

registers.name: STEP_CONFIG
registers.legal_fsm_states: LOAD for write; all for read
registers.side_effects: value is passed unchanged to frozen formal_top for the committed timestep
registers.error_behavior: write outside LOAD, after event acceptance, or with reserved bits set -> error 1

registers.name: SOFT_RESET
registers.side_effects: writing bit0=1 clears latched errors/protocol state, resets frozen formal_top/core without resetting JTAG transport, then enforces a 512-cycle guard before LOAD
registers.error_behavior: bit0=0 or reserved bits set -> error 1
